$comment: Single source of truth for design tokens. Mirrors css/style.css :root for now — see content/design-system.md for the prose layer and the migration plan in scripts/build-tokens.mjs (TODO).

colors.$comment: Hex values are the live source. `role` is what the token is for in practice. `inDarkMode` is the dark variant or null if it doesn't rebind. `usage` notes where it actually appears.

blue.role: Primary accent + paired glyph for orange surfaces
blue.usage: Links, focus tints, hero wash hue, accent dot/arrow on .featured-item--surface-orange

pink.role: Focus / emphasis + paired glyph for purple surfaces
pink.usage: Focus rings, italic display tint, accent dot/arrow on .featured-item--surface-purple

purple.role: Surface accent (paired with pink glyphs only)
purple.usage: Card backplates (.featured-item--surface-purple). Body text on this surface is white; pink is reserved for graphic punctuation (dot, arrow) — never readable text. Theme-stable: does not rebind in dark mode by design.

orange.role: Surface accent (paired with blue glyphs only)
orange.usage: Card backplates (.featured-item--surface-orange). Body text on this surface is white; blue is reserved for graphic punctuation (dot, arrow) — never readable text. Theme-stable: does not rebind in dark mode by design.

pairings.$comment: Documented colour pairings used as a surface + accent system. Body/title text on these surfaces is always white for WCAG contrast.

scale.$comment: Purpose-named scale. Fluid where the use case is fluid (clamps). Replaces 42 inline font-size values across css/style.css.

label.use: UI text — view-link, hero-cta, nav, footer, button labels

lead.use: Case-study lead paragraphs, slightly larger intro text

display.use: Hero H1, big section heads — fluid

hero.use: One-off — the 'Visual / Designer' giant letters on the home hero

exceptions.$comment: Two literal font-size values remain in CSS by design.

html-root.why: Sets the rem base — must be a literal length

marquee-dot.why: em-relative scaling for a pseudo-element dot — intentionally proportional to its container, not the type scale

hero-bigtype-mobile.why: Bespoke responsive bounds for the giant hero letters — different breakpoints need different vw scaling

spacing.$comment: 4px base scale. Numbers are the multiplier (--space-1 = 4px).

radii.$comment: TBD — currently shown in DNA panel but NOT defined as CSS variables. Promote to tokens.

motion.$comment: TBD — durations and easings are magic numbers in CSS/JS. Capture them here.

elevation.$comment: Stated principle: no drop shadows, ever. Hierarchy comes from --border hairlines and --bg/--bg-2 surface shifts. If a future component needs lift, use a thicker hairline or a --bg-2 surface — not a shadow.

imagery.$comment: TBD — see design-system.md for direction. Capture: aspect ratios used, treatment (cutout vs full-bleed), color grading.

components.$comment: TBD — surface the primitives the DNA panel hints at (pill button, ghost button, tag, dot) as documented patterns with token references.
